parameters.content:
## STAGE 01–03 · PUBLIC PROMPT INTAKE, MAX-5 LOCK & PARALLEL SPLIT
- Single Prompt input from Public Web UI
- Strict **Max 5 Leads / Run** cap (protects free API credits)
- Loads **Saved Email Template** + **Excluded Old Leads** (`Make 5 Another Leads`)
- Fires **Parallel Backup Race (LeadPulse AI + TinyFish AI)** + **Free Lead AI Waterfall**

## PARALLEL BACKUP RACE · LEADPULSE AI vs TINYFISH AI (3B-1, 3B-2, 3C)
- **3B-1 LeadPulse AI** & **3B-2 TinyFish AI** start **simultaneously** in parallel
- **First-Result-Wins Race:** Jiska result pehle aata hai woh turant jeet kar aage jaata hai (slow racer auto-cancel!)
- **Standby Guard:** Agar Free Waterfall 5 leads de de, toh Mailmeteor bilkul skip rehta hai!

## STAGE 04 · FREE LEAD AI WATERFALL (1-by-1 Minimum Credit Chain) + GREEN EXPRESS BYPASS
- **Priority (Default Pathway):** `4.1 Prospeo #1` -> `4.2 Prospeo #2` -> `4.25 Clay #1` -> `4.26 Clay #2` -> `4.3 Hunter.io` -> `4.4 Apollo.io` -> `+4.5 Future Lead API Slot`
- **Stop-on-5 Rule:** Jaise hi 5 unique leads poore hon, **Green Express Bypass Rail** baaki saare APIs skip kar deti hai!
- **Pathway Option:** User `TinyFish` pathway chune toh Stage 04 `0ms` me bypass hokar seedha TinyFish -> Smart Email Guesser -> Mailmeteor par jaata hai.

## STAGE 05 · SUFFICIENCY GATE, SMART EMAIL GUESSER (TIME-CAPPED) & MAILMETEOR WEB CHECKER
- **YES (5 Free Leads Ready):** Skip Backup Race & Skip Mailmeteor (`0` checks)
- **NO / <5 Leads (or TinyFish Pathway):** `5B` TinyFish/Race Leads -> **`5G` Smart Email Pattern Guesser (Hard Time Cap <=8s/lead, <=20s total)** -> `5C` Check **ONE BY ONE** on **`https://mailmeteor.com/email-checker`** + `+5D`

## STAGE 06–07 · LOCK 5 UNIQUE LEADS + SMART LINKEDIN + TINYFISH
- Deduplicate against current batch + all previous batches
- **7L Smart LinkedIn:** Direct Profile URL else Auto `Name + Company` LinkedIn Search URL
- **7R TinyFish API:** Official company website finder *(called ONLY if website missing)* + `+7R Extra Scraper Slot`

## STAGE 08 · SAVED EMAIL TEMPLATE + MULTI-LLM FAILOVER
- Loads User's pre-set **"My Email Template"** (`8L`)
- Personalizes Subject & Body per lead (**Zero fake emails / Zero hallucinated facts**)
- **Auto-Failover:** Primary LLM (`xKiro`) -> Backup LLM (`APInex / Gemini`) + `+8R Extra LLM Keys Slot`

## STAGE 09–11 · PROMPT HISTORY, CSV EXPORT & "MAKE 5 ANOTHER LEADS"
- Saves Prompt + 5 Leads + Exclusion Keys + Quota Log
- Returns `nextBatchRequest` so clicking **"Make 5 Another Leads"** loops back to Stage 02 for **Leads 6–10, 11–15...**

## COMPANION PUBLIC UI ENDPOINTS
- `POST /webhook/b2b-smart-leads-template` -> Save/Update **"My Email Template"**
- `GET /webhook/b2b-smart-leads-history` -> Load **Prompt History, Previous Lead Batches & Quota Log**
- `GET /webhook/b2b-smart-leads-health` -> Live **11-Stage Readiness & Provider Status**
